The '''''Primal''''' was a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] that served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The ''Primal'' was a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> present in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]<ref name="last stand" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> at the end of the Clone Wars. Along with the [[Undaunted (Republic cruiser)|''Undaunted'']], another Republic [[Warship/Legends|warship]], it attacked [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that were attempting to flee from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]]. However, while carrying out their duties, the ''Primal'' and the ''Undaunted'' were [[Battle of Cularin/Legends|attacked]] by the [[Maelstrom (Maelstrom-class)/Legends|''Maelstrom'']], another Republic [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]]. The ''Maelstrom'' was commanded by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]], who had evaded [[Death/Legends|death]] during Order 66 by preventing his crew from learning of the order, and he deceived his crew into believing that the ''Primal'' and the ''Undaunted'' had been taken over by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="last stand" />

Jeht was victorious in the engagement and both the ''Primal'' and the ''Undaunted'' were destroyed.<ref name="last stand">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20070201LastStand|text=Living Force: Last Stand|int=Living Force: Last Stand}}</ref>
